raw_html: [[Electric Storm#Electric Storm| Electric Storm]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Electric Storm#Electric Storm| Electric Storm]]:''' This weapon is imbued with an electrifying wrath. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this power will be released, dealing damage to the target and all enemies near it for 15d6 electric damage. A successful Reflex save (DC 39) reduces this by half.
